gun-ar.notes: M4A1-class near shot, 4 real round-robin takes (AR-15 + Marlin 336). Tuned tail on G2.

gun-ak.notes: AK47-class near shot, 4 distinct AK-47 takes from one session. Tuned tail on E2 — the darkest of the four.

gun-smg.notes: SMG near shot, Carl Gustav M45 + PPSh takes. Shortest body, highest tuned tail (C3).

gun-sniper.notes: M40A3-class near shot, 4 Mosin Nagant takes. Longest tail, tuned C2 — the pack's low anchor.

gun-ar-far.notes: Other-player AR at distance: soft attack, thin low end, long jungle tail.

gun-ak-far.notes: Other-player AK at distance, blended with the library's genuine mid-distance AK take.

gun-smg-far.notes: Other-player SMG at distance — the quietest far layer, expect many at once.

gun-sniper-far.notes: Other-player sniper at distance: loudest far variant, longest tail.

reload.notes: Shared 3-stage reload (out / in / rack) with 2 variants per stage plus a slower two-stage bolt for the sniper class.

step-dirt.notes: Jungle floor. Light and clicky: high-passed at 240 Hz with a 2.6 kHz tick on top. Run = same files at higher rate/rate-of-fire.

step-metal.notes: Crate/ship deck. Thimras takes with a 1.6 kHz resonance and a faint tuned ping (C5-G5) so decks belong to the steel-drum family.

hitmarker.notes: 75 ms high steel tick + UI click. Fires constantly, so it is deliberately tiny.

headshot.notes: Hitmarker plus a bell ding a fifth above it — same gesture as the hitmarker, unmistakably 'better'.

kill.notes: Kill confirm: 2-note steel-drum lick (root then fifth, 105 ms apart) over a C2 thump. The pack's dopamine signature.

damage.notes: Damage taken: dark body thud, low-passed at 3.4 kHz so it never competes with the bright feedback family.

nade-pin.notes: Pin pull: two metal clicks, high-passed.

nade-throw.notes: Throw whoosh: two swishes pitched down a major third with a G3 air tone.

nade-bounce.notes: Bounce variants: 1 = dirt/soft, 2 = metal/tin. Wide pitch variance so repeated hops never sound looped.

explosion-near.notes: Banana-nade blast: firework cannons + sub layer + debris, with a tuned G1 boom.

explosion-far.notes: Off-screen blast: 2.6 kHz low-pass, slow attack, 2.6 s of tail.

medal-fury.notes: Tier 4 — C, E, G, C', E'.

medal-streak.notes: Tier 5 — full C-major-pentatonic climb to C''. Same steel note as every other tier, so stacking tiers stays consonant.

ui-click.notes: Menu click: 12 ms tick plus the steel note two octaves up.

ui-deploy.notes: Deploy: C-E-G arpeggio, lands on the fifth.

ui-match-start.notes: Match start: C-E-G pickup into an octave downbeat with a punch and coin shimmer.

ui-match-end.notes: MASHED! / match end: descending flourish into a six-voice pentatonic slam.

amb-jungle-loop.notes: 47 s seamless stereo bed: BigSoundBank forest daytime bird bed + a 16% cicada layer + 29 wrapped bird one-shots. Birds forward by design (+2.5 dB shelf at 6 kHz, -3.5 dB at 260 Hz).

amb-bird-piha.notes: Sparse accent: screaming piha, the signature jungle bird.

amb-bird-chirp.notes: Sparse accent: two-bird chirp exchange, panned apart.

amb-insect.notes: Sparse accent: cicada swell, high-passed at 900 Hz so it sits above the gunfire band.
